item.description:
What's New in v2.8.0

  • New: the Recording tab. Record a whole meeting — the room through your microphone, the call through your Mac — and read the transcript as it happens.
  • Both sides, kept apart. Your microphone and the call audio are recorded as separate tracks, so your side and theirs never get mixed together.
  • Speaker identification. Tells apart the people in the room with you, entirely on device.
  • Summaries when the meeting ends, with action items and chapters. Runs through local Ollama by default — your transcript never leaves the Mac unless you pick a cloud model.
  • Offers to record when Zoom, Teams, Meet, Signal, Slack or FaceTime opens.
  • Import existing recordings — wav, mp3, m4a, mp4, flac, ogg, aac, caf and aiff.
  • Playback with a synced transcript. Click any line to jump to the moment it was said.
  • Survives a crash. Transcript lines are saved as they arrive, so an interrupted meeting keeps everything up to the last few seconds.
  • The dashboard no longer stutters when you scroll it quickly.
  • Fixed: Apple’s built‑in dictation model now downloads missing language assets instead of failing with an error you could not act on.
  • Fixed: Power Mode’s app picker no longer walks through symlinked folders, which could make it hang.
